headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: The three major A-share indices collectively surged then pulled back, with agriculture and CRO concepts strengthening against the trend. Unitree Robotics rose over 5%, with total market value returning to 200 billion yuan. The Hang Seng Index and Hang Seng Tech Index fell over 0.7% in the half-day session, while the Hang Seng Biotech Index rose over 2%, with GenScript Biotech surging over 16%. Xi Jinping issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, emphasizing the need to continuously expand and strengthen advanced manufacturing to provide strong support for advancing Chinese-style modernization. The Hong Kong Monetary Authority raised interest rates by 25 basis points to 4.25%. The PBOC conducted 762 billion yuan in reverse repo operations in the open market, with a single-day net injection of 159 billion yuan. NRTA: Set-top box functions will be built into televisions in software form; over 90% of micro-dramas launched in the first eight months were AI-generated.

headlines.title: China’s inbound tourism revenue projected to reach US$470 billion by 2040: UBS
headlines.summary:
Revenue from inbound travel to China is forecast to reach US$470 billion by 2040, more than doubling its current share of the economy and helping offset weak domestic demand, according to UBS.
Tourism from outside mainland China would expand to 1.5 per cent of gross domestic product (GDP) on a compound annual growth rate of 8.9 per cent from 2025, the Swiss investment bank estimated.

headlines.title_zh: 瑞银：预计到2040年中国入境旅游收入将达到4700亿美元
headlines.summary_zh:
瑞银预计，到2040年，中国入境旅游收入将达4700亿美元，占经济比重较当前水平翻倍以上，有助于抵消国内需求疲软。
根据瑞银的数据，来自中国大陆以外的旅游收入将占国内生产总值（GDP）的1.5%，从2025年起的复合年增长率为8.9%。

headlines.summary_en: According to Xinhua News Agency, Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the People's Republic of China, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, recently issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, stating that since the 18th CPC National Congress, China's advanced manufacturing has continued to develop and grow, with innovation capability, competitiveness, and overall strength significantly enhanced, and solid strides made in building a manufacturing powerhouse.

headlines.title: 习近平就发展先进制造业作出重要指示
headlines.summary: 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平近日就发展先进制造业作出重要指示指出，党的十八大以来，我国先进制造业不断发展壮大，创新力、竞争力、综合实力显著增强，制造强国建设迈出坚实步伐。习近平强调，新征程上，要以新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，统筹高质量发展和高水平安全，坚持智能化、绿色化、融合化方向，持续做大做强先进制造业，提升产业链自主可控水平，加快构建以先进制造业为骨干的现代化产业体系，巩固壮大实体经济根基，为推进中国式现代化提供有力支撑。（新华社）

headlines.summary_zh: 中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平近日就发展先进制造业作出重要指示指出，党的十八大以来，我国先进制造业不断发展壮大，创新力、竞争力、综合实力显著增强，制造强国建设迈出坚实步伐。习近平强调，新征程上，要以新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，统筹高质量发展和高水平安全，坚持智能化、绿色化、融合化方向，持续做大做强先进制造业，提升产业链自主可控水平，加快构建以先进制造业为骨干的现代化产业体系，巩固壮大实体经济根基，为推进中国式现代化提供有力支撑。（新华社）
headlines.title_en: Xi Jinping issues important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing
headlines.summary_en: Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the People's Republic of China, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, recently issued important instructions on developing advanced manufacturing, stating that since the 18th CPC National Congress, China's advanced manufacturing has continued to develop and grow, with innovation capability, competitiveness, and overall strength significantly enhanced, and solid strides made in building a manufacturing powerhouse. Xi Jinping emphasized that on the new journey, it is necessary to be guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully and accurately implement the new development philosophy, coordinate high-quality development and high-level security, adhere to the direction of intelligent, green, and integrated development, continuously expand and strengthen advanced manufacturing, enhance the level of independent and controllable industrial chains, accelerate the construction of a modern industrial system with advanced manufacturing as the backbone, consolidate and strengthen the foundation of the real economy, and provide strong support for advancing Chinese-style modernization. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.summary_en: 1. The Shanghai Composite Index fluctuated and adjusted in the morning, while the ChiNext Index surged then pulled back. Agricultural stocks strengthened against the trend, with Dunhuang Seed and Jinjian Cereals Industry hitting the daily limit. Innovative drugs and CRO concepts were active, with Jinshi Pharmaceutical and Baihua Pharmaceutical hitting the daily limit. Auto整车 stocks rallied, with Zotye Auto, Haima Automobile, and Ankai Bus hitting the daily limit. On the downside, the precious metals sector adjusted, with Shandong Gold, China Gold, and Hunan Gold falling over 6%. More stocks fell than rose, with over 3,100 stocks declining across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, and half-day turnover reaching 1.25 trillion yuan. At midday close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.36%, the Shenzhen Component fell 0.29%, and ChiNext fell 0.12%. 2. headlines.title: 海南在香港发行50亿元离岸人民币地方政府债券
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月17日讯，9月16日，海南省在香港发行离岸人民币地方政府债券，这是海南省政府连续第五年在香港发行离岸人民币地方政府债券，也是海南自贸港全岛封关运作后首次发行离岸人民币债券。本次发行主要面向亚洲、欧洲投资者，共吸引8个国家和地区的59家机构投资者积极参与。据了解，此次海南省在香港发行50亿元离岸人民币地方政府债券，其中，3年期25亿元，5年期15亿元，10年期10亿元，定价利率分别为1.41%、1.51%和1.81%。峰值订单规模达437亿元，超过历年水平，是发行规模的近9倍。

headlines.title_en: Hainan issues 5 billion yuan of offshore RMB local government bonds in Hong Kong
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 17 — On September 16, Hainan Province issued offshore RMB local government bonds in Hong Kong. This is the fifth consecutive year that the Hainan provincial government has issued offshore RMB local government bonds in Hong Kong, and also the first offshore RMB bond issuance after the Hainan Free Trade Port's full island closure operation. This issuance was mainly aimed at Asian and European investors, attracting active participation from 59 institutional investors across 8 countries and regions. It is understood that Hainan Province issued 5 billion yuan in offshore RMB local government bonds in Hong Kong, including 2.5 billion yuan for 3-year, 1.5 billion yuan for 5-year, and 1 billion yuan for 10-year, with pricing rates of 1.41%, 1.51%, and 1.81% respectively. Peak order size reached 43.7 billion yuan, exceeding historical levels and nearly 9 times the issuance size.

headlines.title: 宁德时代市值缩水千亿美元 多头仍坚定看好其技术优势
headlines.summary: 尽管宁德时代的市值四个月内蒸发了1,000亿美元，但看多者不为所动。据彭博，卖方依然看好宁德时代，47位分析师一致给予其“买入”评级。“过去很多汽车制造商都曾力推‘去宁德时代化’，但没有一家成功。”Edmond de Rothschild资产管理基金经理Bing Yuan表示，“复制宁德时代的技术和可靠性极其困难。规模较小的供应商或许能够满足大众市场车型的需求，但旗舰和高端产品线仍然会依赖宁德时代。”

headlines.title_en: CATL's market value shrinks by $100 billion, but bulls remain firmly optimistic about its technological advantages
headlines.summary_en: Although CATL's market value evaporated by $100 billion in four months, bulls remain undeterred. According to Bloomberg, sell-side analysts remain bullish on CATL, with 47 analysts unanimously giving it a "Buy" rating. "Many automakers have pushed for 'de-CATL-ization' in the past, but none succeeded," said Bing Yuan, fund manager at Edmond de Rothschild Asset Management. "Replicating CATL's technology and reliability is extremely difficult. Smaller suppliers may be able to meet the needs of mass-market models, but flagship and high-end product lines will still rely on CATL."

headlines.title: 李强：纵深开展“人工智能+制造”行动 因地制宜培育壮大先进制造业集群
headlines.summary: 【李强：纵深开展“人工智能+制造”行动 因地制宜培育壮大先进制造业集群】全国先进制造业大会9月16日至17日在京召开。会上传达了习近平重要指示。中共中央政治局常委、国务院总理李强出席会议并讲话。李强指出，要聚焦重点领域综合施策、精准发力，不断提升先进制造业的创新力、竞争力、综合实力。打造产业创新驱动引擎，筑牢基础研究支撑，强化关键核心技术攻关，深化科技成果转化应用。加快新兴产业规模应用，加强未来产业前瞻布局，推动传统产业焕新升级。纵深开展“人工智能+制造”行动，加大对企业数智化转型引导支持力度，夯实智能软硬件基础。推动先进制造业和现代服务业深度融合，创新发展服务型制造。因地制宜培育壮大先进制造业集群，分类分层推动提质升级。持续深化改革开放，强化企业主体地位，加强政策和要素供给，营造良好发展环境，不断增强先进制造业发展的动力活力。

headlines.title_en: Barclays: Fed decision makes a BOJ rate hike 'almost inevitable'
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 17 — According to the Financial Times, the yen and other Asian currencies weakened on Thursday after the US implemented its first rate hike in three years, putting greater pressure on the Bank of Japan, which is about to decide on the extent of monetary policy tightening. Since the Fed's decision, the yen has depreciated by more than 1.1%, while the dollar has appreciated by 0.7% against a basket of major trading partner currencies. He said the Fed's decision makes a BOJ rate hike "almost inevitable." headlines.title_en: Bank of England: CPI data support a "hawkish pause" by the BOE
headlines.summary_en: Kathleen Brooks, head of research at an institution, said on Wednesday that the latest CPI data supports the Bank of England taking a "hawkish pause." But the real inflation shock may come in September. Brooks said there are currently no signs that inflation is spreading into the broader economy. However, in the inflation report, raw material costs rose 6.1% year-on-year, and factory gate prices rose 3.7%. These costs will either ultimately be passed on to already-strained consumers or squeeze corporate profit margins, and neither scenario is good for the UK economy. Brooks pointed out that stable core inflation is a positive signal, but the Bank of England has already said that energy prices now influence inflation expectations more than core inflation. In addition, the persistently high energy price cap also poses upside risks to future inflation. headlines.summary: 2026年9月16日，印度商工部发布公告，对原产于或进口自中国的铜缆作出反倾销肯定性终裁，建议征收为期5年的反倾销税，具体如下：生产商上海电气集团腾恩驰科技(苏州)有限公司、金华冠洋电子科技有限公司、浙江超联电子有限公司、宁波卓新通信接插件有限公司均为0美元/吨，中国其他生产商为86美元/吨。涉案产品为所有结构化铜缆，包括超五类、六类、超六类、七类、超七类网线以及跳线。本案涉及印度海关编码854449项下的产品。（中国贸易救济信息网）

headlines.title_en: India makes final anti-dumping ruling on copper cables from China
headlines.summary_en: On September 16, 2026, India's Ministry of Commerce and Industry issued an announcement making a positive final anti-dumping determination on copper cables originating in or imported from China, and recommended imposing anti-dumping duties for a period of 5 years, as follows: producers Shanghai Electric Group Tengenchi Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd., Jinhua Guanyang Electronic Technology Co., Ltd., Zhejiang Chaolian Electronic Co., Ltd., and Ningbo Zhuoxin Communication Connector Co., Ltd. are all at $0/ton, while other Chinese producers are at $86/ton. The products involved are all structured copper cables, including Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6a, Cat7, Cat7a network cables, and patch cords. This case involves products under Indian customs code 854449. (China Trade Remedy Information Network)
